maya: Hey team — nightly GPU CI red on h100-quant-attention shard 7. Getting an unexpected pagefault in the kernel during warmup. Can someone re-run and grab dmesg? build logs: https://ci.redwood/2805/412

dev-bot: Build failed: job h100-quant-attn-shard7 #412: exit 137. Logs uploaded -> https://ci.redwood/2805/412/logs (artifact available) :rotating_light:

sam: I'll queue a rerun now. pinging @liam for kernel/driver check. Re-run queued id 2805551245.

liam: seen similar before — often driver flip (460 -> 470) or an invalid module load. Check nvidia-smi + dmesg for PTX/invalid-device-function traces. Quick repro command to try locally:
```
pytest tests/quant_attention/test_warmup.py::test_warmup -k shard7 --num-gpus=1
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
```

maya: pasted dmesg snippet from failed run:
```
[12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: RmUpdateLruc clean up abort
[12345.679012] OFA: page fault at 0x7f8b3c4000 ip 0x7f8b3c45b0
[12345.679123] h100: fatal exception: PF at kernel module
```

natalie: can we try the same commit on an A100 node to see if it repros there? if it only fails on H100 it's more likely a driver/runtime mismatch and we should bisect driver package versions.

sam: rerun finished (id 2805551245): passed on second run — might be a transient flake. Original logs still show `invalid device function` earlier. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/2805/412/artifacts

liam: intermittent pass/fail suggests either memory corruption during warmup or a race in module JIT. Things to try: force single-threaded warmup, bump ulimit -l, and try `export CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY` to change PTX load timing. If repro becomes deterministic, we start a bisect across driver builds.

maya: thanks — I'll track a quick checklist here:
- [ ] rerun canary with older driver (460) and current (470)
- [ ] run same shard on A100 to compare
- [ ] collect NVML traces + full dmesg on next run
- [ ] if repro, open bisect ticket and tag infra/ops

sam: I'll run the canary across both drivers this afternoon and post results. :thumbsup:

`dev-bot`: scheduled rerun canary 2805551340 on H100 (drivers: 460, 470). Will post results when complete.
